Game Overview

In Deep Sub, the core idea is straightforward: navigate through the ocean depths in Deep Sub, balancing survival and treasure hunting. Master your submarine controls to avoid underwater debris while collecting valuable coins. As the challenges intensify, focus your skills to achieve high scores in this engaging, arcade-style adventure. Can you conquer the depths?
